```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load all targets
```{r}
setwd("/path/to/project/Other data/Borzoi targets")

library(data.table)

targets <- fread(
  "targets_human.txt",   # path to the file
  sep   = "\t",          # tab delimiter (the default, but explicit is clear)
  header = TRUE,         # first line is column names
  quote  = ""            # there are no quoted fields to strip
)
```

## Filter by code words
```{r}
lung_rna <- targets[
  grepl("rna",  description, ignore.case = TRUE) &
  grepl("lung", description, ignore.case = TRUE)
]
setnames(lung_rna, 1, "")     # rename column 1 (“identifier”) to ""
```

## Write to txt
```{r}
# ‘lung_rna’ is the filtered data.table from the previous step
fwrite(
  lung_rna,
  file      = "targets_human_lung_rna.txt",  # or use the original name to overwrite
  sep       = "\t",      # tab-delimited, like the source file
  col.names = TRUE,      # keep the header row
  quote     = FALSE      # don’t add quotation marks
)

```
